basic_details.scholarship_name: Umm Al-Qura University International Student Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Saudi Ministry of Education & Umm Al-Qura University (UQU, Holy City of Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Umm Al-Qura University Campuses (Al-Abidiyyah & Al-Aziziyyah Campuses, Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to leading academic disciplines: College of Computer and Information Systems (Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems), College of Engineering and Islamic Architecture, College of Applied Sciences, College of Business, and Islamic Sharia / Arabic Language.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 500 to 700 fully funded international student scholarships awarded annually across all faculties under Saudi External Scholarships program
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Government bilateral country quota: 45 dedicated seats allocated annually for Pakistani citizens
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 to 5 years for Bachelor degree (including preparatory year); 2 years for Master; 3 to 4 years for PhD, subject to satisfactory academic standing

nationality_requirements: Non-Saudi Muslim citizens residing outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Makkah campus requires Muslim faith)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate applicants must be between 17 and 25 years old; Master's and PhD applicants must be under 35 years old at the time of application.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate) with minimum 75% marks (or 'Very Good' / Grade B+) for Bachelor's; completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum grade of 'Very Good' (Jayyid Jiddan) on secondary school mark sheet.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, or General Science background for College of Computer and Information Systems.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must have graduated within the past 5 years from date of application.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Secondary school graduation certificate must not be older than 5 years at application time.

english_proficiency.notes: College of Computer and Information Systems conducts instruction in English; English Medium of Instruction certificates accepted.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic not required for computer science and engineering programs. Non-Arabic speaking students admitted to Islamic studies complete a 2-year Arabic language diploma at the Institute of Arabic Language for Non-Native Speakers on campus.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Female students must have an eligible Mahram (male guardian) in Saudi Arabia or meet current Saudi university international student housing criteria.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: International Muslim students from across the globe applying to study in the holy city of Makkah.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot have previously held another scholarship from a Saudi educational institution.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver across all academic semesters, including preparatory year.

admission_application_fee.details: Application via the official Study in Saudi portal is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free fully furnished university dormitory accommodation in Makkah Al-Mukarramah, with all utilities, air conditioning, and Wi-Fi included.
accommodation.amount: Free university housing (~SAR 12,000 / year value; ~PKR 910,000 / yr)

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend paid by Saudi Government: SAR 840/month for Undergraduate students (~PKR 64,000/mo); SAR 1,000/month for Master's and PhD students (~PKR 76,000/mo).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy class flight ticket provided between Pakistan and Jeddah (JED) / Makkah for annual summer vacation, plus initial arrival ticket.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Visa and residence permit (Iqama) issued free of charge through the Saudi Embassy in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Free comprehensive medical care at Umm Al-Qura University Medical Center and Saudi Ministry of Health hospitals in Makkah.

food_allowance.details: Nutritious campus meals served at heavily subsidized rates (~SAR 3 to 5/meal; ~PKR 220 to 380/meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book allowance (equivalent to one month stipend) and thesis printing grant upon completion.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: SAR 840 to 1,000 / year plus thesis grant

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Deanship of Scientific Research funds laboratory consumables and conference attendance for research students.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus transportation between student housing, academic faculties, and the Holy Mosque (Masjid al-Haram) for daily prayers.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single major historic university in the holy city: Umm Al-Qura University (Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Saudi Arabia)
participating_institutions: Umm Al-Qura University - Al-Abidiyyah Campus (Main Campus, Makkah)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 600 global university (QS World #551-560, top 15 in Arab World). Preeminent university located in Makkah with ABET-accredited computer science and engineering programs.
available_majors: College of Computer and Information Systems: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems
College of Engineering and Islamic Architecture: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering
College of Applied Sciences: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematical Sciences, Biology
College of Business: Economics, Business Administration, Accounting
Institute of Arabic Language for Non-Native Speakers: 2-Year Intensive Arabic Diploma
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Undergraduate: 4 to 5 years (including foundation year); Master: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Secondary school certificate with 75%+ marks, age 17-25 (undergrad) or under 35 (grad), medical clearance, police character certificate, and attested credentials.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Computer and Information Systems and Engineering have highest competitive cutoffs; College of Applied Sciences and Arabic Language Institute have favorable quota availability.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Apply via the unified 'Study in Saudi' portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa) during the September-November window. Ensure all intermediate and matric documents are attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan before uploading.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Saudi Government Unified 'Study in Saudi' (Minhati) Portal & UQU Admissions
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the Saudi Ministry of Education unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa), select Umm Al-Qura University, choose major, and submit application.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (July - August): Attest Matric and Intermediate certificates/degrees from IBCC and MOFA Pakistan; obtain Police Character Certificate and Medical Fitness Report.
Step 2 (September - November): Register on the 'Study in Saudi' unified portal (studyinsaudi.moe.gov.sa); select Umm Al-Qura University as preferred institution.
Step 3 (November): Upload all required documents (with Arabic translations) and submit application.
Step 4 (December - February): UQU Deanship of Admissions reviews files, verifies eligibility, and ranks applicants.
Step 5 (March - April): Recommended candidates forwarded to Saudi Ministry of Education for government quota allocation and security review.
Step 6 (May - June): Final admission and scholarship notifications issued; electronic visa approval numbers dispatched.
Step 7 (July - August): Student visa stamped at Saudi Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi; e-ticket provided by university.
Step 8 (Late August / Early September): Arrival at King Abdulaziz International Airport (Jeddah); university reception team provides transfer to Makkah campus housing.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated government application: Admission automatically carries full government scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two recommendation letters from former teachers or community leaders uploaded online.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Statement (Arabic or English): Detail academic background, spiritual and intellectual motivation, and future goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required for undergraduate applicants. For Master's/PhD: 2 page study plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Brief academic CV listing education, grades, and extracurriculars.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None required for international external applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation by IBCC/HEC and MOFA Pakistan, followed by Saudi Embassy authentication upon selection.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Arabic translation for all English/Urdu documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the unified Study in Saudi portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color scan of passport info page valid for at least two years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure Pakistani machine-readable passport is scanned in color.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Secondary School Certificate & Detailed Mark Sheet
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official matriculation and intermediate (HSSC) certificates and mark sheets.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by IBCC and MOFA Pakistan, with certified Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive medical fitness certificate from GAMCA-approved center certifying freedom from infectious diseases.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Obtained from GAMCA / GCC approved center in Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official Police Character Certificate certifying clean criminal record.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Issued by Police Khidmat Markaz and attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recommendation letters from former teachers or professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed letters highlighting academic capability and character.
Nadra Birth Certificate attested by MOFA Pakistan with Arabic translation.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual application intake cycle running for Fall semester enrollment.

selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Referee appraisals of character and academic aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UQU International Admissions Committee & Saudi Ministry of Education.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Bilateral quota ranking: Applicants are ranked by academic percentage within country quota allocations (45 seats for Pakistan). Shortlisted candidates undergo ministry background check and final approval by Saudi Ministry of Education.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~27.0% (Dedicated bilateral quota of ~45 seats gives strong odds to well-qualified Pakistani applicants)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 82%+ in Pakistani Intermediate (HSSC / Pre-Engineering / ICS) or 3.35+ CGPA for Master's
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Strong academic record, clean disciplinary and medical history, complete Arabic-translated and attested document dossier.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from across Pakistan with Intermediate certificates from recognized BISE boards.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Indonesia, Nigeria, Egypt, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Turkey

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized commercial recruiters claiming to sell Umm Al-Qura scholarships or visas. Saudi government scholarships are 100% free and strictly processed via the official Study in Saudi portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Umm Al-Qura University scholarship has zero application fees. Never pay fees to private parties.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Apply independently; agents have zero influence over Ministry of Education selection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Document attestation and Arabic translation fees (~PKR 25,000 - 40,000).
Initial settling cash before first stipend disbursement (~SAR 500; ~PKR 38,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: Computer Science is taught in Arabic. (FACT: Coursework in the College of Computer and Information Systems is 100% in English).
CLAIM: Non-Muslims can study at UQU Makkah. (FACT: Makkah campus is strictly restricted to Muslims by Saudi law).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some agencies claim direct admission without ministry approval; all international awards strictly require Saudi Ministry of Education clearance.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain minimum GPA of 2.75 / 5.00 each semester; lower GPA triggers academic warning and stipend review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory regular attendance in all lectures; absence exceeding 20% results in course failure.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic performance reviews reported to the Deanship of Admissions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Students on scholarship visa (Iqama) are strictly prohibited from taking outside commercial employment in the Kingdom.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars must depart the Kingdom upon completion of their degree program within the period specified by Saudi regulations (typically 3 months post-graduation).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or repayment requirements.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminates upon academic dismissal or disciplinary violation; past disbursements are not reclaimed.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Transferring to another university within Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing majors is permitted only within the same college during the first year subject to dean approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard program duration; maximum one semester extension allowed with Ministry approval.
